result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M for a vendor identified as processing customer data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings/counterparts provision and is professionally drafted. However, requiring every coverage to remain in place for one year after expiration or termination—particularly CGL and workers’ compensation—goes beyond the playbook and is not necessary to achieve the stated position.
